common.implementation: Actual React JSX/state/ref/layout effects. Shared requested-state/focus hook copied from first10 React candidate; new per-ID semantic defaults, icons, classes and source contracts. No DOM controller mounting.
common.ownership: value undefined releases control preserving last effective accepted value. defaultValue mount-only. Callback is proposal; false vetoes, promises not awaited; committed parent owner/disable/destruction wins pending action. No arbitrary same-value parent render reset command.
common.items: Duplicate keys retain first; content missing/null uses structured before/emphasis/after, explicit undefined/empty string selects empty. Normalization idempotent. Invalid tab value falls back to enabled first item; empty collection has no controls.
common.keyboard: Tabs: automatic focus activation by default, optional manual Enter/Space, LTR/RTL arrows wrapping enabled items,Home/End. Accordion: all enabled headers in normal Tab order, optional up/down/Home/End plus Enter/Space. Modified/composition keys ignored.
common.focus: Keyed controls and SVG descendants retained on metadata updates; outside focus owner wins. Focus restoration only if a removed/disabled control still owned focus and no outside takeover.
common.forms: All triggers type button, do not submit/reset ancestor forms. Collections have no native field name/FormData/reset commitment; controlled parent can change accepted value.
common.accessibility: Linked unique useId trigger/panel IDs; selected/expanded/disabled; real labels remain in accessibility tree for icon-only mobile tabs. No claims about screenreader/real browser default Tab behavior.
common.themes: Scoped .fr7-nd; semantic surface/ink pairs, hidden state, min-width0; Follow geometry is editorial hard edge. No commercial fonts/images.
common.unverified: Real pointer/keyboard/layout/IME/screenreaders/touch/cross-browser/long-lived stability. No full Radix dependency equivalence.
